note: Reference-list scan (PROTOCOL.md section 1). Studies not found by the database search; each addition names the included paper(s) whose reference list it came from.

additions_for_full_text.title: Meta-analysis identifies five novel loci associated with endometriosis highlighting key genes involved in hormone metabolism.
additions_for_full_text.reason: GWAS meta-analysis (Sapkota 2017) whose full text reports SMR of blood eQTL (Westra 2013) on endometriosis to find causal genes at risk loci.

additions_for_full_text.title: Genetic regulation of disease risk and endometrial gene expression highlights potential target genes for endometriosis and polycystic ovarian syndrome.
additions_for_full_text.reason: Endometrial eQTL study (Fung 2018) with SMR and HEIDI of endometrial eQTL on endometriosis (Sapkota 2017 GWAS); LINC00339 passes, VEZT near threshold.

additions_for_full_text.title: Genetic regulation of methylation in human endometrium and blood and gene targets for reproductive diseases.
additions_for_full_text.reason: Endometrial and blood mQTL study (Mortlock 2019) with SMR and HEIDI on endometriosis (Sapkota 2017 GWAS); GREB1, KDR, WNT4 and others. Methylation claims are mQTL (secondary only).

additions_for_full_text.title: Identification of MKNK1 and TOP3A as ovarian endometriosis risk-associated genes using integrative genomic analyses and functional experiments.
additions_for_full_text.reason: Sherlock/S-PrediXcan study (MKNK1, TOP3A) whose full text reports SMR and HEIDI of GTEx and eQTLGen blood eQTL on endometriosis (UK Biobank, Gene ATLAS).

additions_for_full_text.title: The genetic basis of endometriosis and comorbidity with other pain and inflammatory conditions.
additions_for_full_text.reason: Rahmioglu 2023 GWAS meta-analysis; Supplementary Tables 14-18 report SMR of GTEx uterus, endometrial and eQTLGen eQTL and endometrial and blood mQTL on endometriosis.

additions_for_full_text.title: Global endometrial DNA methylation analysis reveals insights into mQTL regulation and associated endometriosis disease risk and endometrial function.
additions_for_full_text.reason: Endometrial mQTL study (Mortlock 2023) with SMR of endometrial mQTL on endometriosis (31,021 cases); 45 DNAm sites. Methylation claims are mQTL (secondary only).
